rules.description: The de-duplication algorithm must be executed to detect all duplicate applications.
rules.condition: When processing applications, the de-duplication algorithm is run during the verification phase.
rules.outcome: All duplicate applications are identified, including those without Aadhaar or with incorrect bank account details.
rules.evidence_quote: De-duplication algorithm will be run to identify all the duplicate applications including the ones which are without Aadhaar or in which crucial information like Bank account details are found to be incorrect during the verification phase.
